sources.snippet: SummarAI Professional Text Summarization Application SummarAI is an AI-powered text summarization tool built with a fine-tuned T5 Transformer model. It transforms long-form content articles, research papers, reports, meeting notes into concise, accurate summaries while preserving key insights and context.

sources.snippet: Summarizer-HF A full-stack Natural Language Processing (NLP) application that generates concise summaries from long conversations, articles, or dialogue using a fine-tuned T5 Transformer model. Built with a FastAPI backend and a clean, interactive web interface for real-time summarization.
